input: Find a squash court and book a beginner session

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The user's city or neighbourhood determines which courts are even searchable — without a location, no venue can be found.
Knowing whether this is a solo booking, a session with a friend, or a coached group lesson changes the type of slot to look for and how many spaces are needed.
A 'beginner session' could mean a coached/instructed lesson, a casual hire with no coaching, or a beginner-friendly club programme — each requires a different search path.
A hard budget cap affects whether to target pay-and-play public leisure centres, mid-range clubs, or private clubs with membership fees.
The preferred date and time window (e.g. weekday evenings, weekend mornings) directly narrows which courts have available slots worth booking.
The user may have a strong preference for a specific type of venue — e.g. a public leisure centre vs. a private club — which affects the shortlist of options.
Understanding what the user wants to get out of the session (pure fun, learning proper technique, fitness) shapes whether a coached lesson or a free-play hire is the better outcome.

gold.taskTitle: Find and book a beginner squash court session
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate a squash court near them and reserve a beginner-level session to play.

questions.title: What city or neighbourhood should we search in?
questions.description: Establish the user's location so that only reachable courts are considered.

questions.title: Will you be playing alone or with someone?
questions.description: Determine whether a solo coached slot, a paired court hire, or a group lesson is needed.

questions.title: Do you want a coached lesson or just court hire?
questions.description: Clarify whether 'beginner session' means instruction from a coach or simply booking a court to self-play.

questions.title: What is your maximum budget for this booking?
questions.description: A price limit determines whether to target free/low-cost public centres or private clubs.

questions.title: Which days and times work best for you?
questions.description: Knowing the preferred time window allows filtering courts by actual availability.

questions.title: Do you prefer a public leisure centre or a private club?
questions.description: Venue type preference shapes the shortlist before any availability is checked.

questions.title: Is the main goal fitness, fun, or learning technique?
questions.description: The primary goal determines whether a coached lesson or a casual knock-about is the better recommendation.
